fact: Africa Top Success reports the National Assembly voted by acclamation a cybersecurity law that authorises the creation of a National Cybersecurity Agency (ANCY), under the ministries of Public Security and Digital Economy, to secure information systems and handle alerts; promulgation was still to come.

The document states that the Agence Nationale de la Cybersecurite was created by the cybersecurity law of January 2024, and that it appears in neither FY2026 budget volume; the network-security line is FCFA 4,000,000 (proposed, 2026).
A decree creating the Cellule Centrafricaine de l'Internet et de la Sécurité (CCIS), attached to the Presidency, was issued in December 2024, with an organisation decree in January 2025.
